description: Expected results for the official ATS regression test 01_richards_steadystate / fv (github.com/amanzi/ats-regression-tests): steady-state Richards (variably saturated) flow on a generated 1 x 1 x 100 cell column, finite-volume discretization, one 1-s step to steady state. Judged by the official ATS regression checker (regression_tests.py --check-only + test_manager.py, unmodified) against the official gold checkpoint (fv.regression.gold/checkpoint00001.h5) with the official tolerances from richards_steadystate.cfg.

criteria.why: cell pressure [Pa], max-norm difference to gold; cfg: pressure.cell.0 = 2.e-4 absolute
cell water content [mol], relative difference (floor 140); cfg: water_content = 1.e-8 relative 140.
face water flux, relative difference (floor 0.2); cfg: water_flux = 1.0e-8 relative 0.2 (gold name mass_flux_next, matched by the checker's aliases)
boundary-face liquid saturation; cfg: saturation_liquid = 1.0e-6 absolute
cell liquid saturation; cfg: saturation_liquid = 1.0e-6 absolute

reference: Official gold: fv.regression.gold/checkpoint00001.h5 (ats-regression-tests 1f1e27e5, identical at 28ca01bb, the commit ATS 86114e29 records; gold made by ats-1.3-dev-71-gf01049fe). Official tolerances: richards_steadystate.cfg and test_manager.py defaults.
notes: Pass rule = official gold + official tolerances (the six criteria the official checker reports for this test, each must be PASS with a finite difference within its official tolerance, and the tolerance in the checker log must equal the one recorded here). Recorded differences on 2026-10-06: pressure 1.1255e-4, water_content 3.257e-9, water_flux 1.436e-9, saturation boundary 0, saturation cell 1.521e-9, time 0; identical in two clean runs. nonlinear_iterations is from our own run (deterministic, serial).
